summary: This clinical trial is testing a study drug called ARO-ALK7 in adults who have obesity, with or without Type 2 diabetes. The study has 141 participants and is sponsored by Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals. It is classified as Phase 1/2 and is currently Active, not recruiting. Researchers will give the study drug, a placebo, or a combination with another medication called tirzepatide to see how the treatments are tolerated.
